intro.text: An author whose works, banned as treasonous, are read by Elend Venture's secret philosophy club.

items.text: His books questioned the Lord Ruler's way of governing. In Elend's club, Jastes Lekal rated them above a book Elend suggested, while another member found them dull. Elend remarked that such authors knew they would be executed for publishing, and he and Jastes implied the Steel Ministry had probably had Redalevin killed.
